messages.content: What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?

function.name: get_earliest_reference
function.description: Retrieve the earliest historical reference of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source.description: Source to fetch the reference. Default is 'scriptures'

message.reasoning: We need to answer: earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record. The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" We should provide the earliest known historical mention outside of Christian scriptures. That would be references by Roman historians like Tacitus (c. 116 AD), Josephus (c. 93-94 AD), and maybe the Jewish historian Flavius Josephus. Also the Roman governor Pliny the Younger (c. 112 AD). But earliest is Josephus's "Antiquities of the Jews" (c. 93-94 AD) where he mentions James as "the brother of Jesus, who was called Christ". Also the "Testimonium Flavianum" is debated. Also the Roman historian Tacitus mentions Jesus in "Annals" (c. 116 AD). So earliest is Josephus. Also the earliest mention might be in the "Testimonium Flavianum" in Antiquities.
